issues.where: crop C, dark sky haze beside the loop strands (encoded side)
issues.what: the faint red-brown haze behind the stars breaks into soft blotchy blocks, and the colored tints on the stars (blue, orange) are washed to plain white; the dimmest stars are gone
issues.fix: raise the bitrate or lower the CRF for dark low-texture regions (for example with aq-mode 3 or a higher aq-strength) so the haze gets enough bits; keep 4:2:0 chroma from flattening star color by making stars slightly larger or more saturated

issues.where: crop C, red aurora fringe and dark sky to its right (encoded side)
issues.what: the red curtain fades into a slightly blotchy wash with faint macroblock edges, and the small stars near it lose contrast
issues.fix: apply adaptive quantization tuned for dark areas, or add a little dither/grain before encoding so the smooth dark gradient does not get flattened into blocks

issues.where: crops B and C, star field (encoded side)
issues.what: the faintest background stars drop out and the Milky Way dust looks a little smeared, though the bright stars hold
issues.fix: give the background more bits, or brighten the faintest stars slightly so they survive quantization

issues.what: the inner penumbra filaments soften slightly and the dark umbra floor goes a bit flat, with no visible banding
issues.fix: acceptable at this bitrate; a small bump in bitrate or psy-rd would keep the filament edges crisper

issues.where: tile I (0,530), right side, on the bright gradient
issues.what: sharp stars and highlights are flattened into the glow; peaks 40 to 70 above the local background on the source are gone in the encode
issues.fix: ease denoise and AQ on isolated peaks that sit on a gradient so stars against the glow are not erased
